audit.calculation: ITR is recomputed per participant and seed before averaging seeds within participant.

audit.multiplicity: Holm correction is applied separately to the six registered windows of each prespecified component ablation.
One Holm family across four mechanism metrics and three windows (12 paired tests).
One Holm family across the six BETA windows.
One Holm family across three directional contrasts and seven windows (21 paired tests).
One Holm family across both datasets and all three registered windows (six paired tests).

checks: train, validation and test participants are disjoint within every result
the partition covers the declared dataset participant count
test folds cover every participant exactly once per seed and condition
all conditions within a comparison collection use identical folds

deployment.benchmark_command: python -m src.benchmark_deployment or python -m src.benchmark_reference_model with batch size 1, float32, 100 warm-up passes, 1000 measured passes, and one timed CPU thread
deployment.session_scope: single-session empirical latency distribution on one laptop; no independent-session, power-mode, or thermal-state uncertainty estimate
